hadur117.core.melee
Melee (free-for-all) subsystems: opponent tracking, sweep radar, minimum-risk movement, target selection, circular targeting and posture strategy, and each opponent's melee profile block (MMEM-1), driven each tick by MeleeController.

    StepSurf.drive(Point2D.Double me, Point2D.Double prev, Point2D.Double to, double energy, List<StepSurf.Foe> foes, long now, List<MinimumRiskMovement.Wave> waves)
    Drive from me to to the way the seam drives (MeleeSeam.goTo): the body turns toward the step at Robocode's rate (10 - 0.75 |v| degrees a tick), backwards when that is the shorter turn, at most 4 px a tick while the turn left is over 45 degrees, 1 px a tick faster to 8 and braking 2 a tick (through zero on a reversal), for at most StepSurf.TICKS ticks or until the waves have passed: the waves' damage on the way, and the mean crowd along the path.
